title: Bounded influence along a subsequence
statement: Let $d_k$ be a sequence of dimensions, and let $f_k:\{-1,1\}^{d_k}\to\{\pm1\}$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function for each $k$. Fix $0<\epsilon<1/2$, and suppose the normalized threshold widths of this family do not tend to zero. Then there are a constant $C\in\mathbb R$, a strictly increasing sequence of indices $\phi(k)$, and, for each $k$, a parameter $p_k$ strictly between the lower and upper threshold parameters of $f_{\phi(k)}$, such that $\epsilon<\Pr_{p_k}[f_{\phi(k)}=-1]<1-\epsilon$ and the total influence of $f_{\phi(k)}$ under the $p_k$-biased product measure is at most $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on each corresponding cube
The family has a coarse threshold, meaning its normalized threshold widths do not tend to zero
